question: Which two statements describe the process of upgrading an EPLD on a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch? (Choose two.)
options: EPLDs are only capable to be upgraded to the latest EPLD image.
EPLD upgrades are capable to be completed without powering down the module during the upgrade.
An upgrade verification identifies the impact of each EPLD upgrade.
The EPLDs for all the modules on a switch must be upgraded at the same time.
EPLDs are capable to be upgraded without replacing the hardware.
theory: Before committing to an EPLD upgrade, the 'install all epld' / 'install module epld' workflow runs a compatibility/impact check that reports which modules are upgradable and whether the impact is disruptive or nondisruptive for each one. EPLD images simply reprogram existing programmable logic already on the module's hardware, so an upgrade never requires swapping any physical hardware - it is a firmware-level update, not something requiring every EPLD on every module to be upgraded together. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - EPLD Upgrade)
